question: Rajasthan ka kshetrafal kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Rajasthan ka kshetrafal 3,42,239 sq km hai — Bharat ka sabse bada rajya (~10.4%). | Galat kyun: Baaki teenon vikalpon me aankda galat hai (4,42,239; 3,22,239; 2,42,239). | Concept: Rajya ka kshetrafal ↔ desh me sthan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 3,42,239 — sabse bada rajya. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography.

question: Rajasthan ki sabse unchi choti kaun si hai aur unchai kitni?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Guru Shikhar (Mount Abu, Sirohi) 1,722 m — Rajasthan ki sabse unchi choti. | Galat kyun: Taragarh aur Kumbhalgarh ki unchai 1,722 m nahi hai; 'Abu 1,200 m' sabse unchi choti nahi hai. | Concept: Rajya ki sabse unchi choti ↔ unchai ↔ sthan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Guru Shikhar = 1,722 m (Mount Abu). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Aravalli parvat shrinkhala kis disha me faili hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Aravalli parvat shrinkhala Uttar-Purab se Dakshin-Pashchim disha me faili hai; yah duniya ki sabse purani shrinkhalaon me se ek hai. | Galat kyun: Uttar–Dakshin, Dakshin-Purab–Uttar-Pashchim aur Purab–Pashchim Aravalli ki disha nahi hain. | Concept: Shrinkhala ki disha = uske failaav ki disha. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Aravalli = NE–SW (Delhi se Gujarat tak). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan ki sabse lambi nadi kaun si hai jo keval Rajasthan me behti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Banas keval Rajasthan me behne wali sabse lambi nadi hai (Rajsamand se Tonk); ise 'Van ki Asha' kaha jata hai. | Galat kyun: Chambal Rajasthan ki sabse badi nadi hai lekin MP se aati hai; Mahi aur Luni chhoti hain aur rajya se bahar bhi behti hain. | Concept: 'Keval Rajasthan me' = poori nadi ek hi rajya me. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Banas = sirf Rajasthan ki nadi (Rajsamand–Tonk). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Chambal nadi par kaun se bandh hain?
option_a: Gandhi Sagar, Rana Pratap Sagar, Jawahar Sagar
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Chambal par Gandhi Sagar, Rana Pratap Sagar aur Jawahar Sagar bandh hain. | Galat kyun: Mahi Bajaj Sagar Mahi par hai; Pong aur Bhakra Beas/Sutlej par hain; Bisalpur Banas par aur Jaisamand ek jheel hai. | Concept: Nadi ↔ uspar bane bandh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Chambal = Gandhi, Rana Pratap, Jawahar Sagar (teen bandh). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Bharat ki sabse badi khare pani ki jheel kaun si hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Sambhar Jheel Bharat ki sabse badi khare pani ki jheel hai; yahan namak utpadan hota hai. | Galat kyun: Nakki, Pichola aur Pushkar meethi pani ki jheelein hain aur chhoti hain. | Concept: Jheel ↔ pani ka prakar (khara/meetha) ↔ aakar. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sambhar = sabse badi khari jheel = namak. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Udaipur ko kis naam se jana jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Udaipur 'Jheelon ka Shahar' hai (Pichola, Fatehsagar, Udaisagar). | Galat kyun: Jaipur Gulabi Nagari, Jodhpur Neela Shahar hai; 'Sunehra Shahar' Jaisalmer se juda hai. | Concept: Shahar ↔ upnaam. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Udaipur = jheelein; Jaipur = gulabi; Jodhpur = neela; Jaisalmer = sunehra. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan ka rajya vriksh kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Khejri Rajasthan ka rajya vriksh hai; Rohida rajya pushp hai. | Galat kyun: Rohida rajya pushp hai (vriksh nahi); Peepal aur Bargad Rajasthan ke rajya chinh nahi hain. | Concept: Rajya chinh (vriksh/pushp/pakshi/pashu) alag-alag hote hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Khejri = vriksh; Rohida = pushp. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan ka rajya pakshi kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Godawan (Great Indian Bustard) Rajasthan ka rajya pakshi hai. | Galat kyun: Unt rajya pashu hai, Chinkara rajya pashu ke roop me ullekhit hota hai, Mor Bharat ka rashtriya pakshi hai. | Concept: Rajya pakshi ≠ rajya pashu ≠ rashtriya pakshi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Godawan = rajya pakshi; Mor = rashtriya pakshi. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Ranthambore National Park kahan hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Ranthambore National Park Sawai Madhopur me hai. | Galat kyun: Sariska Alwar me, Keoladeo Bharatpur me, Desert NP Jaisalmer me hai. | Concept: Rashtriya udyan ↔ jila. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Ranthambore = Sawai Madhopur (baagh); Sariska = Alwar; Keoladeo = Bharatpur (pakshi). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Keoladeo National Park kis liye prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Keoladeo (Bharatpur) pakshiyon ke liye prasiddh hai — Siberian crane jaise pravasi pakshi yahan aate the; yah UNESCO World Heritage (1982) hai. | Galat kyun: Unt, bagh aur hiran Keoladeo ki pehchan nahi hain (bagh Ranthambore se juda hai). | Concept: Udyan ↔ uski visheshta. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Keoladeo = Bharatpur ke pakshi (UNESCO 1982). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan me sabse zyada varsha kahan hoti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Rajasthan me varsha paschim se purab badhti hai; Jhalawar (~100 cm) me sabse zyada aur Barmer (~10 cm) me sabse kam varsha hoti hai. | Galat kyun: Barmer, Bikaner aur Jaisalmer paschimi shushk kshetra me hain — varsha wahan sabse kam hoti hai. | Concept: Varsha ka gradient — paschim (kam) se purab (zyada). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Varsha = paschim se purab badhti hai (Barmer 10 cm → Jhalawar 100 cm). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Thar marusthal Rajasthan ke kitne kshetra ko gherta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Thar marusthal Rajasthan ke lagbhag 60% kshetra ko gherta hai; yah duniya ka sabse ghana aabadi wala marusthal hai. | Galat kyun: 75%, 50% aur 40% galat anumaan hain. | Concept: Marusthal ka vistar = rajya ka hissa. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Thar = ~60% (lagbhag aadhe se zyada). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Indira Gandhi Nahar ka udgam kahan se hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Indira Gandhi Nahar Harike Barrage (Punjab) se nikalti hai — Rajasthan ki sabse badi nahar pariyojana. | Galat kyun: Bhakra Sutlej par, Bisalpur Banas par, Gandhi Sagar Chambal par hai — IGNP ka udgam inme se koi nahi. | Concept: Nahar ↔ udgam sthal. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: IGNP = Harike Barrage (Punjab) se. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Zawar (Udaipur) kis khanij ke liye prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Zawar (Udaipur) Bharat me zinc-lead ka sabse bada kshetra hai. | Galat kyun: Bauxite, loha aur koyla Zawar ki pehchan nahi hain. | Concept: Khanij kshetra ↔ khanij. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Zawar = Zinc-Lead (Udaipur). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Bhadla Solar Park kahan hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Bhadla Solar Park Jodhpur jile me hai — duniya ke sabse bade solar parkon me se ek. | Galat kyun: Barmer, Jaisalmer aur Bikaner me bhi solar pariyojanayein hain, lekin Bhadla Jodhpur me hai. | Concept: Urja pariyojana ↔ jila. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Bhadla = Jodhpur (solar). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan kis fasal ke utpadan me Bharat me No.1 hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Rajasthan Bajra aur Sarso ke utpadan me Bharat me No.1 hai. | Galat kyun: Makka-Jowar, Gehun-Chawal aur Ganna-Kapas me Rajasthan No.1 nahi hai. | Concept: Fasal ↔ utpadan me sthan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Bajra + Sarso = Rajasthan No.1. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Census 2011 ke anusar Rajasthan ki jansankhya ghantva (density) kitna tha?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Census 2011 me Rajasthan ki jansankhya ghantva 200/sq km tha (Bharat: 382). | Galat kyun: 150, 250 aur 382 galat hain — 382 Bharat ka aankda hai, Rajasthan ka nahi. | Concept: Ghantva = jansankhya / kshetrafal. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Rajasthan 200, Bharat 382 (2011). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md; Census of India 2011.

question: Pakistan se Rajasthan ki seema kitni lambi hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Rajasthan ki Pakistan se antarrashtriya seema lagbhag 1,070 km hai. | Galat kyun: 800, 500 aur 1,500 km galat anumaan hain. | Concept: Antarrashtriya seema ki lambai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pakistan seema = ~1,070 km. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Jaisamand jheel kis naam se bhi jani jati hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Jaisamand jheel ko Dhebar Jheel bhi kaha jata hai; yah ek kritrim jheel hai. | Galat kyun: Rajsamand, Fatehsagar aur Pichola alag jheelein hain. | Concept: Jheel ↔ uska dusra naam. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jaisamand = Dhebar Jheel. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.

question: Luni nadi kahan vilin hoti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Luni antarvahini nadi hai — Rann of Kutch me vilin hoti hai, samudra me nahi girti. | Galat kyun: Bay of Bengal aur Arabian Sea me girne wali nadiyan samudra tak pahunchti hain; Luni Yamuna me nahi milti. | Concept: Antarvahini nadi = samudra tak nahi pahunchti. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Luni = andar hi khatm (Rann of Kutch). | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 3.

question: Barmer me kaun sa tel kshetra prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Barmer me Mangala oil field prasiddh hai (Bhagyam, Aishwariya bhi hain). | Galat kyun: Ankleshwar Gujarat me, Bombay High Maharashtra ke tat par, Digboi Assam me hai. | Concept: Tel kshetra ↔ sthan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Mangala = Barmer ka tel. | Source: notes/04_geography_rajasthan.md.
